title: Very cheap and almost gets the job done
text: Very cheap and almost gets the job done. Assembly was difficult because the legs are not level. Once we hammered it a little we got it together, and then had to shove cardboard under it to make it stable. Small surface and drinks/plants will fall off the smooth unlevel surface.
